messages:
olivia_csm: Quick hit from today's onboarding reviews — 8 customers reported the same two things: (1) session drops during long interactive flows, (2) confusion about how route mapping affects token billing. Can we triage for quick customer-facing fixes?

sam_csm: Adding context: customers say token usage spikes when they call multiple routes in a single session. They expected per-route cost isolation but see a single aggregated bill.

rachel_product: Thanks. Let's separate into: urgent infra mitigation (session stability), stopgap CS tooling (admin CSV export), and product scope (per-route billing UI + doc updates).

dev_pablo: On the infra side I looked at a subset of logs. Disconnects correlate with load spikes plus our LB idle close threshold. Short-term fix: bump idle to 10m on onboarding fleet and enable a short keepalive ping. Long-term: patch client SDK to send optional heartbeats. I can do the LB config change today behind a feature flag.

kai_docs: I'll draft two artifacts: a KB article "Understanding routes & token billing" and a one-pager CS can share. For the CSV we need schema — can someone propose minimal columns?

notif-bot: Labels added: [onboarding], [billing-clarity], [infra].

rachel_product: Minimal CSV schema suggestion: customer, route_id, route_name, tokens_used, window_start, window_end. Example: 

```
customer,route_id,route_name,tokens_used,window_start,window_end
AcmeRetail,route_01,chat-default,2145,2026-03-15T09:00Z,2026-03-15T09:30Z
```

sam_csm: That will help CS explain spikes. Also request: can we include an approximate cost column (tokens * unit_price) so customers see dollars for clarity? Even an estimated field would be helpful.

dev_pablo: I can include estimated_cost in CSV if we expose the pricing tier in the admin admin query. Will do admin-only export behind auth (no UI) and mark it as "for CS only". ETA: 36 hours for endpoint + 24h for tests.

kai_docs: Great. I'll draft the KB and a short walkthrough GIF showing how to map CSV rows to product routes. ETA: 2 days.

rachel_product: Also adding a small triage field to our backlog tickets: "renewal_risk" (yes/maybe/no) and "customer_impact_score" (1-5). CS, please include those when filing. We'll use that to promote urgent fixes.

olivia_csm: Noted. I'll tag the two accounts in CRM as renewal-risk and pause proactive renewal outreach until we confirm the LB fix.

dev_pablo: LB keepalive PR opened. Toggle will be in staging later today; rollout to onboarding fleet once we sanity-check.

notif-bot: Reminder set: follow-up check in 72h.

kai_docs: Draft KB shared in Drive. Included sample CSV and interpretation notes. One unresolved Q: should we auto-aggregate overlapping route calls into a session-level row or keep per-route rows? Feedback from CS?

sam_csm: Keep per-route rows. Customers want to see which feature (route) drove the spike. Aggregates can confuse. We can provide an optional session_summary export later.

rachel_product: Agreed. Action list summarised: (1) Dev -> LB keepalive + idle bump (owner: dev_pablo; ETA: 24-36h). (2) Dev -> Admin CSV export with estimated_cost (owner: dev_pablo; ETA: 48-72h). (3) Docs -> KB + GIF + FAQ (owner: kai_docs; ETA: 48h). (4) CS -> tag renewal-risk + use triage fields when filing tickets.

olivia_csm: I'll message affected customers with an acknowledgement and ETA once LB is in staging. Also scheduling a 10-minute walkthrough for any customer that wants a quick explain.

dev_pablo: Staging smoke looks good. Pushing LB toggle to onboarding fleet now. Will post PR link when merged.

kai_docs: KB updated with CSV sample and interpretation. Linking it in the CS playbook now.

rachel_product: Thanks team. If any account shows renewed churn signals, escalate to me and Sam immediately. Otherwise we'll close this triage next Tuesday during backlog grooming. :rocket:
